validity.description: Synthetic parameters selected for an exactly solvable 1:1 binding step with transparent equilibrium, transient, threshold, and receptor-balance checks.

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Praezisionsmedizin, Sections 4.4-4.5, pp. 129-132
sources.role: receptor, binding, detection, and cell-layer architecture

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M5.1 analytical receptor-ligand baseline, version 1.0.0
sources.role: synthetic parameters, analytical equations, reference result, and acceptance rules

limitations: All kinetic, concentration, volume, receptor, and threshold values are synthetic software-test parameters.
The ligand concentration is a constant external reservoir and is not depleted by receptor binding.
The model assumes homogeneous deterministic 1:1 mass-action binding without cooperativity, internalization, synthesis, degradation, spatial gradients, or stochastic molecule counts.
Threshold crossing is a software event only and does not yet activate a nanodevice or return a cell-state change to another layer.
The cell volume only converts receptor concentration to amount and is not a geometry-resolved cell.
